notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796300/2c067e252af3462ce40d4c39c60250b33261e7da.gif

Fluid water:
- Now the water can flow and spread, even flooding the whole world
 
New buildings:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796300/4e47a960bbf7ca4596b50e925d3c2bfcc715b7e9.png

-Bonfire:  Cooking food can increase the satiety of food

-Barbecue grill:  A larger barbecue grill that can cook 3 foods at the same time

- Simple water purifier:  boiling the sewage into clean water

-Automatic water purifier:  can automatically filter sewage without fuel

-Electric water purifier: can automatically pump water after connecting the water pipe, without manual addition, but it needs to consume batteries

-Grinding wheel:  can repair items

- Battery charger:  able to charge the battery

-Automatic sprinkler:  After connecting to the water source, it can automatically water the surrounding crops, requiring battery consumption

-Water pipe:  The pipe connecting to the water source. Please insert one end into the water when using it

-Water pipe diverter:  Can divert water to multiple water pipes

- Ore washing machine: can refine rare metals in ores

- Teleportation Gates:  Let you teleport between different teleportation gates

- Runestone Table: allows you to strengthen runes

-Leather drying rack:  can process animal fur into leather

- Small furnace:  Capable of processing ore

-Large melting furnace: can process more ores and has a 3 times faster smelting speed

-Carbonization furnace: can convert wood into coal

- Rope rack:  Capable of placing the rope to the ground

-Zipline:  The rope allows you to quickly shuttle through the air

- Stronghold:  A stronghold allows you to recruit NPCs

- Battery:  can provide energy for the equipment

 
Vehicle:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796300/93c9986eb60235d956f349bd890864ec4e8dd35e.png
-Excavator: a powerful excavation tool that can quickly collect a large amount of ore and requires battery power

other:
- Treasure Hunt Removed: The last updated treasure hunt task has been removed, and we will add it back at the right time
 
- Basic guide: added task guidance and help
 
-Continuous construction: Now, by holding down the construction button and dragging, you can continuously construct a whole wall of blocks
 
-Incompatible with the archive: This update has made a lot of changes, and the old game data conflicts with the new version. Please recreate the world and characters
 
-Online exception: There are many exceptions in the online part of Version 1.1, which will be fixed in Version 1.2
 
- Small problem: fixed a lot of things

notes.title: Treasure Hunt Update(Deprecated)
notes.content:
Modified initial backpack: When you create a new character, your initial backpack will have a shovel and detector to start your first challenge ： treasure hunting.
Add:Stamina,Hunger,Equipment durability
Terrain generator adjustments: add more plain terrains
Blacksmith: Will now be able to join the fight
Parry: The Parry time has been extended. Now equipping a shield will further extend the Parry time.
Status bar UI modification
Weapon value changes
Nerf: Skeleton,Wolf boss
Coal and copper mines can be found when you dig the ground
